metadata.question: Was the sulfer dioxide concentration higher over Cumbre Vieja than the Funchal Island on October 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about sulfur dioxide (SO2) concentration comparison between two locations (Cumbre Vieja and Funchal Island) on a specific date (October 18, 2021). For SO2 concentration, I should use the TROPOMI/Sentinel-5P SO2 product. Let me break this down: 1. Data Collection: Use 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2' collection 2. Bands: 'SO2_column_number_density' for SO2 concentration 3. Locations: - Cumbre Vieja volcano in La Palma, Canary Islands: approx [-17.84, 28.57] - Funchal Island (Madeira): approx [-16.91, 32.65] 4. Date: October 18, 2021 (specific day) 5. Processing: Extract mean SO2 values for both locations using buffers 6. Validation: Check for valid pixels and reasonable SO2 values I'll need to: - Create point geometries for both locations - Filter the SO2 collection for the specific date - Extract mean SO2 values using reduceRegion - Compare the values and determine if Cumbre Vieja had higher concentration - Handle cases of no data or invalid results Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cumbreVieja = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.84, 28.57]); const funchal = ee.Geometry.Point([-16.91, 32.65]); const date = '2021-10-18'; // 2. Data Acquisition - TROPOMI SO2 data const so2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .select('SO2_column_number_density'); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = so2Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`SO2 images on ${date}: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the SO2 image for the date const so2Image = so2Collection.first(); // 3. Extract SO2 values for both locations with buffers const bufferDistance = 5000; // 5km buffer // Function to extract SO2 mean and count function extractSO2Stats(point) { const buffer = point.buffer(bufferDistance); const stats = so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats; } const cumbreStats = extractSO2Stats(cumbreVieja); const funchalStats = extractSO2Stats(funchal); const cumbreMean = cumbreStats.get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const cumbreCount = cumbreStats.get('SO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); const funchalMean = funchalStats.get('SO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const funchalCount = funchalStats.get('SO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Cumbre Vieja: SO2=${cumbreMean?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels=${cumbreCount}`); console.log(`Funchal: SO2=${funchalMean?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels=${funchalCount}`); // 4. Validation checks if (cumbreCount === 0 || funchalCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (cumbreMean === null || funchalMean === null || isNaN(cumbreMean) || isNaN(funchalMean)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final comparison console.log(`Difference: ${(cumbreMean - funchalMean).toFixed(6)}`); if (cumbreMean > funchalMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
